bible: A consistent series of quiet documentary photographs, shot on a medium-format camera with a 50mm-equivalent lens, natural muted grade with soft contrast and fine film grain, no filters or HDR look. Light is soft, diffuse daylight from the upper left in every shot, with gentle falloff and soft contact shadows only. Palette: a dark matte slate-green tabletop (#1C2421) with a faint stone grain; warm uncoated map paper (#F2ECDF) with a slight tooth; heather browns, dry grass ochres and a pale warm-grey sky outdoors; the only strong colours are solid cover inks of moss green (#8FAE77), vermilion (#C63B22) and river blue (#3E7BA3), and only on the folded map covers. Paper surfaces are always completely blank and unprinted. Exclusions in every image: no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no logos, no watermarks, no signatures, no printed map lines or contour drawings, no compass, no pens, no people, no hands, no laptops or screens, no props other than those described.

shots.sheet: 16:10 landscape, at least 2400px wide. Strictly top-down, orthographic view (camera perfectly perpendicular, no perspective tilt). One large sheet of blank, unprinted cream map paper (#F2ECDF) lies unfolded and flat on the dark slate-green table (#1C2421). Crisp fold creases divide the sheet into a 4 x 2 grid of equal panels: three vertical creases and one horizontal crease, each crease a soft valley of light and shade with very slight relief, the panels very gently undulating. The sheet is centred with its edges exactly parallel to the frame, filling about 90% of the width and 84% of the height, so an even band of table shows on all four sides (about 5% left and right, 8% top and bottom). Soft daylight from the upper left; the paper is evenly lit, brightest at upper left and only slightly darker at lower right, with no hard shadows on it; a thin soft contact shadow along the sheet's right and bottom edges. The whole paper surface is the clean zone: it will be printed with a map in code, and the bottom-left panel will hold the title and buttons, so it must be perfectly blank, smooth and evenly lit.
shots.pockets: 3:1 wide landscape, at least 2400px wide. Strictly top-down, orthographic view, the same dark slate-green table (#1C2421) and the same light from the upper left. Three identical walking maps folded down to pocket size (each a portrait rectangle about 2:3) lie side by side in a straight row, evenly spaced with generous equal gaps, edges parallel to the frame, vertically centred, together filling about 80% of the width. Each folded map shows only its front cover: the top 62% of each cover is a flat solid ink block, left cover moss green (#8FAE77), middle cover vermilion (#C63B22), right cover river blue (#3E7BA3); the bottom 38% of each cover is plain blank cream paper (#F2ECDF). Folded edges visible along the sides with thin layered paper edges, soft contact shadows to the lower right. The colour blocks and the cream strips are clean zones for live type: completely blank, no text, no emblem, no stripes, no printing.
shots.trail: 21:9 wide landscape, at least 2400px wide. Eye-level photograph of an upland moor ridge in soft late afternoon, overcast-bright. A narrow footpath of bare worn earth runs from the lower-left foreground through brown heather and dry ochre grass, curving into the middle distance towards a low, gentle ridge line. Horizon at about 58% of the frame height. In the right third, beside the path, stands one short weathered oak waymarker post (about knee to hip height in frame, lower-right third) with a round blank pale cream disc (#F2ECDF) fixed flat near its top, facing the camera squarely; the disc is completely blank, no arrow, no symbol. The top 50% of the frame is a calm, even, pale warm-grey sky (around #D9D6CC), lighter and clean across the left two-thirds where a headline will be set; no birds, no strong clouds, no sun disc. Light diffuse from the upper left. No people, no fences, no buildings, no text anywhere.
